pages.title: Sundown (Gordon Lightfoot song)
pages.extract:
"Sundown" is a song by Canadian folk artist Gordon Lightfoot, from the titular album, released as a single in March 1974.
"Sundown" reached number one on the U.S. Billboard Hot 100 and easy listening charts and number 13 on the Hot Country singles chart, as well as number one in Canada on RPM's national singles chart. It was Lightfoot's only single to reach number one on the Hot 100.

"'''Sundown'''" is a song by Canadian [[Folk music|folk]] artist [[Gordon Lightfoot]], from the [[Sundown (Gordon Lightfoot album)|titular album]], released as a single in March 1974.

"Sundown" reached number one on the U.S. [[Billboard Hot 100|''Billboard'' Hot 100]] and [[Hot Adult Contemporary Tracks|easy listening]] charts<ref>{{cite book |title= The Billboard Book of Top 40 Hits: Eighth Edition |last=Whitburn |first=Joel |author-link=Joel Whitburn |year=2004 |publisher=Record Research |page=368}}</ref> and number 13 on the [[Hot Country Songs|Hot Country singles]] chart,<ref>{{cite book |title= The Billboard Book Of Top 40 Country Hits: 1944-2006, Second edition|last=Whitburn |first=Joel |author-link=Joel Whitburn |year=2004 |publisher=Record Research |page=201}}</ref> as well as number one in [[Canada]] on ''[[RPM (magazine)|RPM]]''{{'}}s [[List of number-one singles of 1974 (Canada)|national singles chart]]. It was Lightfoot's only single to reach number one on the Hot 100.
